title: Prep Notes, Week 4
dek: Jadarian Price is out, so Emanuel Wilson takes the Seattle backfield with George Holani; Keenan Allen missed Friday's practice and is a true London decision.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Sun 12:25 PM ET: Terry McLaurin is inactive in London; pivot to Stefon Diggs. Ladd McConkey (foot) is expected to play at SEA, WR39 for me. Tyjae Spears (ankle) is active at BAL. Zay Flowers (WR9) and Kenyon Sadiq (TE14, a borderline start) are active.

Updated Sat 6:25 PM ET: Carolina elevated Ja'Seem Reed Saturday, which points to Jalen Coker (quad) sitting vs DET; Darren Waller is TE18 for me, a streamer Sunday night.

Updated Sat 12:25 PM ET: Keenan Allen is ruled out for London; pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson. Terry McLaurin is still questionable, but Washington's beat reporting says he is likely to miss; plan on a 1 PM receiver and check the 8:00 AM ET inactives.

Updated Fri 5:50 PM ET: Zay Flowers (hamstring) is questionable after a limited Friday practice the Ravens listed as rest, following a full Thursday. He stays WR9 for me vs TEN; check Sunday's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Friday's final reports are in. Eleven fantasy-relevant players are out, nobody is doubtful, and eight are questionable. The late surprise is in Seattle: Jadarian Price is out with the chest, so Emanuel Wilson moves up to RB31 in a split with George Holani. Nico Collins and DJ Moore have no designation and play. Rankings are for full PPR.

The true Sunday decisions are Keenan Allen and Terry McLaurin in London (inactives at 8:00 AM ET), Ladd McConkey and Mike Evans in the 4:25 PM window, and Jalen Coker on Sunday night. Have a 1 PM backup ready for anyone you play in London or late.

report.read: Grade 2 hamstring, three to four weeks; the backup starts vs NYJ.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Jared Goff, QB8 for me against CAR's depleted secondary.

report.read: Missed every practice; O'Connell still calls him day to day. Addison drew 9 of Kyler Murray's 29 throws at TB.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Jordan Addison, WR25 for me this week, a high-end WR3.

report.read: Ruled out with Hall and Mason Taylor; Garrett Wilson and Kenyon Sadiq take the targets.
report.verdict: Out. Sit him and use any WR3 from the Menu.

report.read: Ruled out after three missed practices; week to week. Braelon Allen played every snap after Hall left at DET.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Braelon Allen, RB20 for me this week, an RB2.

report.read: His second straight missed game; Sadiq had 8 of 37 targets at DET without him.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Juwan Johnson, TE8 for me this week, if Sadiq's back worries you.

report.read: Sprained MCL, week to week; Mundt and Ertz split the tight end snaps.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Juwan Johnson, TE8 for me this week.

report.read: Missed every practice; two to three games expected.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR33 for me, a low-end WR3.

report.read: Out with Smith and Goedert; Wicks ran 81 percent of the routes at CHI.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR33 for me.

report.read: Mike Macdonald said he reinjured the chest Wednesday. Charbonnet is Week 5 at the earliest, so Wilson and Holani split it.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Emanuel Wilson, RB31 for me, a low-end RB3.

report.read: Dislocated left elbow; practiced in a brace all week and was ruled out. Marcus Mariota threw 3 TD vs SEA.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Marcus Mariota, QB17 for me, a streamer vs IND.

report.read: Three missed practices. Jacory Croskey-Merritt has 58 percent of the team's carries.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Jacory Croskey-Merritt, RB24 for me this week, an RB2.

report.read: Full Thursday, then limited Friday with rest listed beside the hamstring. He played 21 snaps in Week 3 coming back and caught 5 of 6 for 84.
report.verdict: Active, with left tackle Ronnie Stanley (toe) active too. WR9 for me vs TEN.

report.read: Limited Thursday and Friday, then Carolina elevated Ja'Seem Reed from the practice squad Saturday, the move Dave Canales said would come if Coker could not play. Darren Waller led CAR with 8 targets in Week 3 on a 51 percent snap share.
report.verdict: Outside my top 50 receivers even if he plays; sit him. Plan on Coker sitting: Darren Waller is TE18 for me, a streamer Sunday night.
report.watch: Sunday night inactives at 6:50 PM ET

report.read: Went the wrong way Friday: limited Wednesday and Thursday, then no practice. The Colts ruled him out Saturday and elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine, so Downs and Warren take the targets.
report.verdict: Out for London. Pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson (WR38).

report.read: Back to limited Friday but did not run routes in the open portion. Quentin Johnston ran routes on 37 of 43 dropbacks vs BUF.
report.verdict: Expected to play per NFL Network. WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; keep a 1 PM option off your bench until the 4:25 PM inactives.

report.read: Limited all week from the landing on his Week 3 touchdown; 58 percent of the routes and 21.6 percent of the targets.
report.verdict: Active, with Mason Taylor and Adonai Mitchell inactive. TE14 for me, a borderline start this week.

report.read: Three missed practices, side work only Friday. John Lynch says he will make every attempt to play; Brandin Cooks was promoted for depth.
report.verdict: Outside my top 50 receivers with the ribs, a dart throw at best; sit him. George Kittle and Christian McCaffrey take the targets either way.

report.read: Full practice Friday, so he should play; Tony Pollard has no designation and 80 percent of early downs.
report.verdict: Active. RB39 for me, a dart throw behind Pollard; sit him.

report.read: A new hamstring listing Friday, limited. Washington's beat reporting Saturday says he is now likely to miss London, with Mariota at quarterback. Stefon Diggs is the next man up.
report.verdict: Inactive in London. Pivot to Stefon Diggs, WR27 for me, a high-end WR3.
